text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: inference-hosting-prod (us-west-2) p95 latency spike — baseline ~120ms -> observed ~580ms at 2026-03-17T02:15:23Z. Paging @sam (oncall). Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-live-triage>
sam (oncall): ack, joining. Any immediate customer errors? :point_up:
support-bot: Customer impact summary: 3 customers reported request timeouts (route: /v1/embeddings). Error rate +5% on embeddings. No data loss reported.
julia: attaching top spans from tracing collector (traces bucket): s3://traces/5167890123/top_spans.json
julia: span summary: increased syscall/blocking spans in model-runner process around serialization layer. Example span:
```
span_id: 0x7f8a
name: socket_write
duration_ms: 6.2
tags: {node: gpu-03, pid: 4123}
stack: [__sys_sendmsg, __schedule, io_wait]
```
mike: uploaded short perf dump from gpu-03: s3://perf-dumps/5167890123/gpu-03.perf
mike: sample counters (gpu-03) before alert:
```
runqueue_len: 3
cpu_migrations/sec: 120
softirq/irq: 950/120
```
erin: note — I rolled kernel patch 5.16.21-pa to canary nodes (gpu-02, gpu-03) at 2026-03-17T01:30:00Z for security backport. Could correlate.
sam (oncall): hypotheses:
- H1: kernel preempt/scheduler change in 5.16.21-pa increased tail syscall latency for short blocking ops -> p95 jump
- H2: batching behavior changed due to slight tail increases causing larger queues
Need: runqueue traces, full perf.data, KV-cache hit rates, and model-runner thread dumps.
julia: timeline (collected from traces/logs):
- 01:28 UTC: minor p95 upticks on canary nodes
- 01:30 UTC: kernel patch rolled to canary (gpu-02/gpu-03)
- 02:10 UTC: alerting threshold crossed cluster-wide
- 02:15 UTC: oncall paging triggered
mike: pushing truncated log excerpt from gpu-03 indicating blocking syscall durations:
```
[01:29:58] model-runner[4123]: syscall read 0.0058s
[01:30:12] model-runner[4123]: syscall read 0.0063s
[02:11:04] model-runner[4123]: syscall wait 0.0071s
```
ops-runbot: Mitigation options (ordered):
1) rollback kernel on canary nodes -> quick diagnostic
2) failover traffic from canary to standby pool (us-west-2-fallback)
3) temporarily lower batching target (e.g., 64 -> 32) to reduce queuing
4) enable per-route rate limit on embeddings for noisy tenants
5) collect perf record/trace bundles for deep RCA
sam (oncall): executing 1) now. Rolling back gpu-02 first. I'll update with p95 on node.
julia: applying temporary batch target change on model-runner-hosts in us-west-2 (64->32) to reduce latency amplification.
mike: initiating perf record capture on gpu-03: `perf record -a -g -o /tmp/perf_gpu-03.data` (started 02:21 UTC)
support-bot: Notifying impacted customers: "We are investigating an intermittent latency increase in embeddings; mitigations in progress. We'll follow up with details." (sent 02:22 UTC)
sam (oncall): rollback gpu-02 completed at 02:33 UTC. Node-level p95 dropped from ~560ms -> ~150ms for traffic routed to gpu-02. Trending downward.
mike: perf counters after gpu-02 rollback:
```
runqueue_len: 1
cpu_migrations/sec: 18
softirq/irq: 420/60
```
erin: confirmed kernel on gpu-02 reverted to 5.16.20 at 02:32 UTC. gpu-03 still on 5.16.21-pa.
julia: tracing shows reduced syscall tail on gpu-02 after revert. Span durations median dropped to ~0.6ms, p95 ~1.2ms on gpu-02.
sam (oncall): rolling back gpu-03 now. Also routing new traffic to fallback pool while we finish.
mike: gpu-03 rollback completed 02:41 UTC. Cluster p95 back to ~130-180ms across steady state.
ops-runbot: Recommendation: hold 5.16.21-pa rollout. Run multipart RCA: kernel-change deep dive + tracing correlation + batching sensitivity tests. Capture perf.data from affected nodes and upload to artifacts.
erin: initial root cause hypothesis: 5.16.21-pa introduced changed preempt scheduling behavior that increased syscall latency variance for short blocking syscalls in our workload pattern -> amplified batching/queueing effect -> p95 regression.
julia: we have span bundles and will run tail-correlation between syscall spans and request latency. Uploading mapping: s3://traces/5167890123/span_mappings.json
sam (oncall): owners for follow-ups:
- kernel/patch rollback & vendor comms: erin
- traces and telemetry correlation: julia
- mitigation playbook updates & perf artifacts: mike
- customer comms & impact summary: support-bot
I'll create RCA ticket and link artifacts.
support-bot: Customer update sent: "We implemented mitigations (kernel rollback on canary, traffic failover). We are investigating root cause and will provide an RCA." 02:50 UTC
sam (oncall): closing live triage channel. Handoff to RCA owners — please use #postmortems and attach artifacts. Good job team. :white_check_mark:
